reason: Retain the initial candidate without a source-feedback revision. All fixed seeds 271, 409 and 557 were attempted once through native isolation and succeeded with 3000 complete rows, estimable rank-4 analyses, source feedback and generated-only analysis; no failed or favorable seed was omitted. I inspected every supplied report. The SBP BMI associations per 5 kg/m2 were 3.08145, 3.77497 and 3.70898 mmHg; DBP associations were 3.02947, 3.23238 and 3.05800 mmHg; adjusted residual correlations were 0.49509, 0.52618 and 0.53800. No generated SBP was below DBP. The nonlinear conditional age surfaces, BMI/age dependence, heteroscedasticity and joint support restriction mean these OLS results need not equal generator conditional coefficients; no implementation or extraction error was identified by the permitted checks. All seven strict source checks remain unavailable, with the richer-adjusted pooled INTERSALT slopes not replaced by a differently adjusted statistic. Five Beijing age>=65 descriptive contrasts per seed were computed under assumed conventions, on 361, 380 and 368 generated age65-79 rows. Relative to the source, SBP means differed by -1.4864, +0.0827 and -0.5441 mmHg; SBP SDs by -3.7016, -2.9491 and -3.2157 mmHg; DBP means by +3.8849, +4.6191 and +3.4118 mmHg; DBP SDs by -0.0859, -0.5763 and -0.0655 mmHg; raw SBP/DBP correlations by -0.0270, +0.0216 and +0.0091. The persistent lower SBP dispersion and higher DBP means are acknowledged discrepancies, not declared Monte Carlo noise or successful source fit. Their causes cannot be partitioned among assumed structure, age truncation, covariate composition, treatment, country and selection from the admitted aggregate evidence. Calibrating target-generation parameters to these approximate contrasts would require an additional unverified equivalence assumption, so I retain the predeclared construction and its limitations. No further retrieval was chosen, and no local generator execution, target quantitative access or other-author access occurred. This decision supports an assumption-explicit virtual cohort for the requested descriptive analyses; it does not establish target accuracy, causal effects, patient-level recovery, national representativeness or quantified transport uncertainty. All three successful outputs of this candidate are selected together.
